references.title: nlohmann JSON dump API
references.supports: Serialization is linear in input size.
references.does_not_establish: Not a profile of Cubey or evidence for upgrading the JSON library.

references.title: Khronos descriptor update reference
references.supports: Ordinary bindings used by pending commands cannot be rewritten.
references.does_not_establish: Does not supply Cubey versioned binding or retirement implementation.

references.title: Khronos CPU/GPU synchronization sample
references.supports: Granular frame completion avoids unnecessary pipeline drains.
references.does_not_establish: Sample performance is not a Cubey timing or permission to drop dependencies.

references.title: Khronos command-buffer management sample
references.supports: Release measurements without validation layers, pool recycling and reasonable command-buffer granularity avoid measurement and allocation overhead.
references.does_not_establish: Draw-call sample does not explain Cubey compute granularity penalties.

references.title: Khronos timeline semaphore sample
references.supports: Completion counters support lifetime synchronization; excessive queued work raises latency.
references.does_not_establish: A new timeline API is not required by the proposed one-owner experiment.

references.title: Khronos queue scheduling specification
references.supports: Queue priority does not promise scheduling or quality-of-service guarantees.
references.does_not_establish: Does not identify the fastest queue arrangement for this workload.

references.title: Keeter 2020 MPR research page
references.supports: GPU interval evaluation and local expression reduction support a spatial-program direction.
references.does_not_establish: No Cubey raw-F32/R16 equivalence or drop-in evaluator performance is established.

references.title: Pinned Fidget GPU source
references.supports: WebGPU rendering includes tape interpretation and simplification, separately from native CPU JIT.
references.does_not_establish: No library integration, CSG adapter or benchmark was performed.

references.title: Aaltonen GDC 2018 Claybook slides, pages 20-21
references.supports: A limited-range sampled field is modified using previous volume values and new modifications.
references.does_not_establish: Different storage, error and history contracts from Cubey; no copied implementation.

references.title: Frisken et al. 2000 adaptively sampled distance fields
references.supports: Adaptive reconstruction accuracy is an explicit representation choice.
references.does_not_establish: Not an undo design or proof of Cubey cache identity.
